name: Maharajganj

queries.query: महाराजगंज सिवान बिहार भू नक्शा बिहार भू अभिलेख आधिकारिक
queries.result: Official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer identifies Bihar state, Siwan district code 16, Maharajganj subdivision code 02 and Maharajganj circle code 15; local selectors include urban mauzas Pasnauli and Sihouta. Exact WUP point-to-mauza association was not resolved. Viewer JavaScript draws village/plot layers through WMS images and has a plot-identify call, but no full-vector polygon response was found.
queries.method: Official district/state pages plus bounded anonymous GET/POST selectors and public config/index.js inspection.

queries.query: Maharajganj Siwan Bihar cadastral map official BhuNaksha land records
queries.result: The Siwan District Administration links Bihar land records; Bihar Revenue & Land Reforms lists Bhu-Naksha as a public revenue-map viewer. Siwan/Maharajganj selectors work, but point-to-mauza and parcel geometry remain unverified.
queries.method: Official government pages and direct public selector inspection.
